buckets.description: Histogram bins with a count, in order; absent for categorical breakdowns and when unavailable. Bins start at the effective start time and step by the bucket width; with an unbounded lower bound they start at multiples of the width from the Unix epoch.

reasons.description: Why the breakdown is partial or unavailable: unsupported_filter, degraded_bucket, missing_collection, history_before_origin, archive_limit, live_timeout, live_limit, live_unavailable, collection_disabled when the application's workflow metrics collection is turned off, and not_requested for a live part the request did not ask for, which is not a failure.

values.description: Categorical counts, most frequent first; absent for the histogram and when unavailable.

statusCounts.description: The count split by workflow status, omitting statuses with none; it sums to count. History and live combine by adding status by status.

maxQueueWaitMs.description: The longest queue wait (dequeue time minus creation time) among the counted workflows, in milliseconds; absent when none was dequeued. History and live combine by taking the larger value, not by adding.

statusCounts.description: The count split by workflow status, omitting statuses with none. Present on queue breakdown values only, where it sums to count. History and live combine by adding status by status.

trimmed.description: The value was cut to the length limit, so filtering the list by it is not exact.

value.description: The observed value, cut to 1,024 characters; empty for null and overflow.

collectionState.description: lagging: two or more closed five-minute intervals are uncollected. disabled: the application's workflow metrics collection is turned off; every breakdown is unavailable with collection_disabled and the archive's fields are absent.

coveredEnd.description: The archive's watermark: completions before it are collected or were skipped. Absent while collection is disabled.

effectiveEndTime.description: The request's upper bound snapped up to the histogram tier; absent when unbounded.

effectiveStartTime.description: The request's lower bound snapped down to the histogram tier; absent when unbounded.

lastGapEnd.description: End of the most recently skipped completion interval; absent when none was skipped. A range starting before it may be missing workflows created in it, and is partial with missing_collection.

legacyCompletionCoverage.description: Workflows without a completion timestamp (pre-migration history) are never collected.

origin.description: Completions from here on are collected, minus skipped intervals; nothing before it ever is. Absent while collection is disabled.

semantics.description: Counts are terminal contributions observed by the collector, attributed to creation time: deleted workflows stay counted and a resumed workflow can count twice.

statusOnlyBuckets.description: Buckets with collapsed detail among those the categorical breakdowns read. Absent while collection is disabled.

timeBucketSizeMs.description: The effective histogram width. Absent while collection is disabled.

unsupportedFilters.description: Active filters the archive could not apply.

liveContext.description: What a live request echoes. Absent while collection is disabled, when there is no supplement to ask for.

components.description: The components the chart sums over the archive. The nonterminal component is listed only when the request asked for its part of the chart: the categorical charts under breakdowns, the histogram under bins.

state.description: unavailable for an archive-side reason, whatever live returned; partial when a component the chart sums failed or the live lookback leaves an uncovered completion interval (missing_collection).

breakdowns.description: This component's own counts; unavailable with the outcome's reason when it failed.

detail.description: What went wrong, for a failed outcome.

outcome.description: empty_window: nothing to ask, the watermark is at the request time (terminal only). not_attempted: an unsupported filter, no source work. not_requested: the request set nonterminal to none, so no source work (nonterminal only). disabled: the application's workflow metrics collection is turned off, so no source work. timeout: the shared 20-second budget elapsed. row_limit: over 20,000 rows. no_executor: no eligible executor. failed: dispatch failed or the reply was unusable. A failed terminal component does not stop the nonterminal one; only the spent budget stops later requests.

receivedAt.description: When the reply arrived; absent without one.

startedAt.description: When the source request was dispatched; absent when it never was.

windowStart.description: Terminal only: the completion window [windowStart, windowEnd); absent when not dispatched.

effectiveEndTime.description: Absent for an unbounded upper bound.

effectiveStartTime.description: Absent for an unbounded lower bound.

watermark.description: The archive's watermark; the live terminal window starts here.

statusOnlyBuckets.description: Buckets with collapsed detail among those the history categorical breakdowns read.

terminalLookbackMs.description: How far before the request time the terminal window can reach; an older watermark leaves a hole.

unsupportedFilters.description: Active filters the archive could not apply.

get.description: Returns the Transact Enterprise features the calling API key's org may use; a feature reported false is not included in the org's plan. An org past its plan limit gets 403 with X-DBOS-Error: past_limit instead. Self-hosted Conductor grants every feature, and with OAuth disabled it needs no credentials. Otherwise any valid API key is accepted regardless of its permissions, and user credentials are rejected with 401.

get.description: Computes how many executors each of the application's versions needs right now, given the backlog of its stored autoscaling policy's queue. Returns one entry per version. 404 when no policy is installed; 400 when the policy queue is no longer scalable. Requires a DBOS Teams subscription.

Computes how many executors one application version needs right now, given the backlog of the stored autoscaling policy's queue. Made to be polled per version, e.g. by one KEDA ScaledObject per version's deployment. The latest version is always sized to at least 1; an old version reports 0 once it has no work left on that queue, signaling it can be torn down. 404 when no policy is installed or the version was never registered; 400 when the policy queue is no longer scalable. Requires a DBOS Teams subscription.

post.description: Renders the workflow filter charts from conductor's archive of observed terminal activity, without querying the application's database. 404 when the application has no archive yet.

Asks one executor, under one 20-second budget, for terminal completions since the history response's watermark (at most 15 minutes back) and for the workflows still pending, both within the effective creation range. Source failures are per-component outcomes, never errors. 400 for a context outside this application's archive, 404 without an archive.
